items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Slats Paris was working with Chick, maybe Slats told him about you. [INTERVIEWEE] Maybe so.

ctx.x: Wait a minute--I did get an offer from Chick Webb; that's when I said I wasn't thinking about leaving Trent's band.
